# louppe media culler

> free, open-source photo, video, and audio culling for macOS. the app is named Louppe

review media and read-only text in Gallery or Grid. mark decisions, stars, and color labels; filter and select files. find duplicates, similar photos, and bursts locally. group RAW+JPEG pairs, inspect at 100%, and play video or audio. organize folders, clean up to macOS Trash, copy or move files, route copies, and write XMP sidecars

- [website](https://louppe.eu/): features and download
- [download](https://github.com/murlexander/louppe-media-culler/releases): macOS releases
- [source](https://github.com/murlexander/louppe-media-culler): application code
- [blog](https://louppe.eu/blog/): development and release notes
- [privacy](https://louppe.eu/privacy/): app data and optional website analytics
- [author](https://alex-markin.com/): artist Alex Markin

Gallery, Grid, a captioned 25-second Demo, and a written walkthrough show the app in use

Website languages: [English](https://louppe.eu/), [Español](https://louppe.eu/es/), [简体中文](https://louppe.eu/zh/), [हिन्दी](https://louppe.eu/hi/), [Português](https://louppe.eu/pt/), and [العربية](https://louppe.eu/ar/)
